title: 5-inch FPV drone frame
description: A true-X freestyle quadcopter frame for 5 to 5.3 inch props, CNC routed from carbon fibre: four 5 mm arms between a 2 mm bottom plate and a 2 mm top plate on purple anodised aluminium standoffs, a 30.5 mm flight controller stack, motor mounts for 16 and 19 mm bolt circles, a cage for a 19 mm camera and real 5.1 x 4.3 x 3 props lofted at their pitch.
